_comment: Posterior-inference (VI + HMC) settings for the age model. DELIBERATELY a separate file from age_model_config.json: age_run_map fingerprints that whole config, so editing it here would make every existing MAP checkpoint refuse to resume. The MAP source run is NOT named here -- it is age_run_map's own OUTPUT_DIR (run_names.map + HOUFIN_MAP_PROFILE suffix), so the posterior stages cannot point at a stale MAP. Env vars (HOUFIN_HMC_*, HOUFIN_VI_*, HOUFIN_PROBE_*) override individual leaves. Overlay with $AGE_POSTERIOR_CONFIG.

run_names._comment: {map_run} is the MAP directory's basename (e.g. age_map_float32_run_17_new_z_quick90, which already carries precision + profile), so trials from different MAP fits never share an output directory. Select the MAP with the same AGE_MODEL_CONFIG overlay + HOUFIN_MAP_PROFILE it was fitted with.

probe._comment: Gradient timing + dense Hessian of the potential at the MAP point, in the unconstrained space NUTS samples. The Laplace inverse mass matrix is SoftAbs: each axis gets width 1/sqrt(max(|lambda|, eig_floor)), so a negative eigenvalue (a saddle along that axis) keeps its curvature scale; eig_floor only caps genuinely flat axes at sd 1/sqrt(eig_floor).

vi._comment: Low-rank MVN guide initialized at MAP, fit under nominal priors (prior_scale=1). Stage 1 of the NeuTra arm.

hmc._comment: NUTS on prior_scale=1. num_samples must be a multiple of chunk: warmup runs in ONE job (numpyro cannot split an adaptation window), sampling in chunks checkpointed via mcmc.last_state. initial_step_size is per metric: a unit/diag metric starts in a space where dispersal_random has sd 1e-3, so a step of 1 diverges on the first trajectory.
hmc._init_jitter_comment: Chains >0 start at MAP + init_jitter * (Laplace draw). Measured at run_18's MAP (roughness probe), U - U(MAP) at jitter 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 was ~30-100 / ~800 / ~8900 nats, against ~220 for the typical set of a 439-d Gaussian: the potential rises far faster than the Laplace quadratic, so 0.5 already starts deep in the tail (that chain diverged through warmup). 0.25 starts near the typical set.

refine._comment: L-BFGS (optax, zoom linesearch) on the UNCONSTRAINED potential NUTS samples -- the posterior at prior_scale=1 including the change-of-variables Jacobians, so its optimum is the point the probe's Laplace metric should be centred on (AutoDelta's MAP omits the Jacobians; only concentration and quality_conc_mult are constrained, so the two differ little). Run in float64: float32 U carries a ~1 nat noise floor. Stops when U falls by less than tol_du over tol_window iterations, or |grad| < tol_grad.
